definitions.explanation: The Japanese government ministry in charge of foreign relations, diplomacy and embassies, headed by the {外務|がいむ}{大臣|だいじん}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{外務省|がいむしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勤|つと}めている→勤める：00902_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: My older brother works at the Foreign Ministry.

examples.japanese: {外務省|がいむしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声明|せいめい}→声明：03763_seimei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The Foreign Ministry issued an urgent statement.

examples.japanese: {外務省|がいむしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{治安|ちあん}→治安：13269_chian⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪化|あっか}した→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{渡航|とこう}→渡航：17919_tokou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}える→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧よう⟦{呼|よ}びかけた→呼びかける：06480_yobikakeru⟧。
examples.english: Citing deteriorating security, the Foreign Ministry urged people to avoid travel to that country.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
The ministry is in Kasumigaseki, Tokyo, and ⟦{霞|かすみ}が{関|せき}→霞が関：31031_kasumigaseki⟧ stands for the whole bureaucracy. Travelers know it for its {海外安全|かいがいあんぜん}⟦ホームページ→ホームページ：05869_hoomupeeji⟧ (travel safety warnings); passports are issued in its name through prefectural offices.
